top_signals.title: BOJ holds rates at 1%, warns of core inflation exceeding 2% target
top_signals.summary: The decision comes as speculation continues to swirl around whether the Bank of Japan will hike rates at a faster pace.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Yen’s Intervention Gains Continue to Fade After BOJ Stands Pat
top_signals.summary: The yen gave up more of its intervention-driven gains after the Bank of Japan left interest rates unchanged, with traders turning their attention to whether Governor Kazuo Ueda can offer support for the currency at his press conference later Friday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: BOJ Holds Rate Steady And Upgrades View on Economy
top_signals.summary: The Bank of Japan kept its policy settings unchanged and nudged its economic growth forecast higher, signaling confidence that the economy remains on track for further policy normalization. Bloomberg's Shery Ahn has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: PBOC’s Weaker Daily Fixing to Temper Yuan Gains, Analysts Say
top_signals.summary: China’s central bank set the yuan’s fixing at a weaker-than-expected level, a move that some analysts said may indicate a desire to slow the pace of gains after the currency climbed to a three-year high.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Swiggy, Eternal Stocks Surge as Zepto’s India IPO Hits Roadblock
top_signals.summary: Shares of the main competitors to Indian rapid-commerce firm Zepto Ltd. are set for their best month in years after the loss-making company’s planned initial public offering hit a roadblock.

alerts.title: Commission endorses Malta's €60 million Social Climate Plan to support vulnerable households and small companies in the clean transition
alerts.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 29 Jul 2026 The European Commission has today endorsed Malta's Social Climate Plan – the fourth national plan adopted under the Social Climate Fund using revenues from carbon pricing to ensure a fair and inclusive clean transition. Malta's plan will mobilise €60.6 million until 2032, including €45.4 million from the European Union.
